chapter_title_en: The Arrogance of the Central Plains
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 226: Black Lotus of the Capital - A Clash Between Southern Wastes and Central Plains
chapter_meta_description: In the Great Shang capital, Central Plains aristocrats mock Southern Wastes cultivators. Yu Wenfeng challenges Yin Feng's dark lotus flame but is defeated. Meanwhile, Xiao Chen watches silently.
og_title: Chapter 226: The Black Lotus of the Capital | World of Immortality
og_description: Central Plains arrogance meets Southern pride as Yu Wenfeng falls to Yin Feng's black lotus. But Xiao Chen is alive and watching.
twitter_description: Yu Wenfeng is humbled by Yin Feng's flame. Xiao Chen's survival adds a dark edge to the capital's arrogance.
